comment_text.value: Except it is coming out now that those audits are hollow. The fact that the AI companies are lining up to support them proves how useless those audits will be. Abbott just put out that order for political posturing leading up to the election. The entities responsible for implementing the audits (PUC & ERCOT) will drag their feet until after the mid-terms and if Abbott wins he'll conviently forget about them.

comment_text.value:
The midterm grade spread in my Precalculus I course this summer was median 70% +/- 30% across all students, with four retakes allowed penalty-free. It was show your work with pencil and paper. The teacher noted that it’s the first time since Covid that no students were caught cheating by Proctorio.

I warned (in a fashion) the head of a college district last year that the “two-year degree” was not long for this world. They were not convinced. Least enjoyable ‘told you so’ ever.

story_title.value: I teach calculus at Berkeley. Some of my students can't do middle school math
